name: Pressable MCP
description: Pressable is managed WordPress hosting built for agencies, developers, and growing businesses. This connector lets you manage your hosting infrastructure directly from Claude: check site health, pull logs, run WP-CLI commands, and control your sites through conversation. Backed by the infrastructure and expertise of Automattic, powering millions of WordPress sites worldwide.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pressable MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pressable MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.pressable.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pressable MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pressable MCP provides these MCP tools: describe_tool, discover_tools, and execute_tool.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pressable MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Pressable MCP in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Pressable MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pressable MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Pressable MCP is developed by Pressable. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
